short: Equestrian Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose
twin: the source print (womens-equestrian-horse-girl-broke-on-purpose-hoodie, 3324 x 3609, a Sand print) had HORSE GIRL and BROKE ON PURPOSE in dark brown slab (low contrast on dark) above and below the horse-at-a-barn-door art (rows 389-3376 kept; the art has its own worn, ragged lower edge, no straight cut); both lines were cropped away and re-set as HORSE / GIRL above and BROKE / ON PURPOSE below. The rust, cream and blush art reads on light and dark blanks, so one art file serves both.
